title: Enclave Onboarding Playbook: Quarterly Sprint Map and Acceptance Shims
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a repeatable, low-friction onboarding playbook for enterprise 'enclave' private deployments (VPC + customer-managed network boundary) that maps into quarterly sprint commitments and explicit OKR signals. The playbook should reduce time-to-first-query for pilot customers, standardize acceptance gates across security/ops/infra, and provide a sequenced cadence for engineering, support, and solutions partnerships.

Scope: Quarter-focused runbook covering discovery -> pre-onboarding checklist -> integration sprint plan -> canary activation -> upgrade/rollback windows. Includes: encrypted key exchange (KMS/HSM integration steps), RBAC mappings, network validation checklist, telemetry & SLO thresholds, customer migration scripts, handoff to success. Excludes fully air-gapped on-prem appliances (separate epic).

Success metrics (OKRs):
- O1: Reduce average time from contract signature to production-ready enclave from 28 days to <=12 days for the initial 10 pilots.
- KR1: Documented and automated preflight checklist used by 100% of pilots.
- KR2: 10 pilot customers onboarded with no critical security findings in initial audit.
- KR3: Enclave median 99th percentile tail-latency within 1.5x hosted baseline (measured during canary).

Constraints & trade-offs: prioritizing low-friction automation (scripts, templates) over deep customizations in Q2. Some customers will require bespoke network rules; those route to Tier-2 onramp which is out of scope for this sprint. The playbook will initially support a single major customer-supplied KMS provider (AWS KMS) with a path for adding GCP/Azure in Q3.

Owners & stakeholders: PM: Maya Chen; Eng lead: Omar Reyes; Security reviewer: Priya Nandakumar; Solutions Eng: Lars Petrov; Console owners: Jolene Park; Customer Success liaison: Daniel Ortiz.

Rollout plan (quarter map):
- Sprint 1 (weeks 1-3): Discovery + runbook skeleton + preflight automation scripts. Deliverables: confluence runbook draft, network validation terraform module, sample KMS integration checklist.
- Sprint 2 (weeks 4-6): Implement onboarding automation (templates + scaffolding), develop telemetry dashboard for cohort tracking, create canary activation playbook. Deliverables: github PR for automation repo, console dashboard widget prototype, customer-facing onboarding guide.
- Sprint 3 (weeks 7-9): Pilot 3 lighthouse customers (cohort A) — full runbook execution with Solutions Eng; collect signals and make corrections. Deliverables: pilot retro doc, updated runbook v1.1, checklist automation tweaks.
- Sprint 4 (weeks 10-12): Scale to additional pilots, finalize acceptance shims and release playbook as internal golden path. Deliverables: internal training, runbook published, OKR review.

Monitoring & SLOs: Define SLOs for network validation time (<=4 hours), key exchange handshake success (>=99%), and canary latency thresholds. Dashboard name: Console -> Private Onboard -> Enclave Cohort. Alerts: PagerDuty escalation if preflight automation fails for >2 pilots in a sprint.

Acceptance Shims: small, easily-configurable steps inserted into the onboarding flow to lock or bypass gates depending on customer risk profile (e.g., 'strict-kms-validation' shim, 'managed-egress-proxy' shim). Shims must be auditable and reversible.

Deliverable artifacts: Confluence runbook page, onboarding terraform module in infra-onramp repo, sample customer checklist in Drive, two public PRs for automation (see comments for links).
acceptance_criteria: Automated preflight checklist runs end-to-end for a sandbox tenant (no manual network steps >90% of time)
